phase: preparation for documentary implementation; no executable source

acceptance.parent_criterion: Board SDK exposes buses/power/entropy/key handles/algorithms/storage/display/input/lifecycle without Nostr schemas or policy.
negative_review_questions: Does any generic service depend on Nostr semantics?
Does a trait/boolean/mock falsely claim hardware support, entropy quality, SE algorithm/non-exportability or consent?
Can hidden blocking/cancellation or partial output violate the documented failure contract?

acceptance.parent_criterion: Start with libraries in one trusted firmware image; document absence of inter-application security isolation.
planned_evidence: standalone consumer proof only after a separately accepted real implementation scope
negative_review_questions: Does ordinary Rust privacy/library linkage get mistaken for isolation from malicious firmware?
Is an unused crate/plugin/process framework introduced without a real consumer?

acceptance.parent_criterion: Pin electrical contracts from hardware and design version compatibility without circular or sibling-path dependencies.
planned_evidence: exact electrical/configuration compatibility and source-pinning contract
current unresolved H04 inputs and per-criterion pending disposition when actual pinning is impossible
acyclic repository dependency and standalone checkout rules
negative_review_questions: Were inherited pins/rails/connector details guessed or declared approved?
Can unknown/incompatible tuple succeed through defaults, a sibling path or circular dependency?
Was this parent criterion falsely closed without the required actual hardware contract?

acceptance.parent_criterion: Development, owner-secured and product-qualified states have explicit transition limits and secret-reset requirements.
planned_evidence: explicit S04/H01 dependencies and physical proof owners
MCU owner and vendor SE rights/immutable object distinctions
negative_review_questions: Does reset erase only MCU flash while privileged SE state survives?
Are finite budgets, irreversible ownership, lost credentials, rollback or partial reset hidden?
Can product qualification be minted by firmware or a support flag?

checks: Verify every source audit row against its exact Git object (mode/blob/bytes/SHA256) and all parent criteria byte-for-byte against f2 graph.
Review dependency/service/lifecycle semantics and primary source locators; preserve unknown/unperformed outcomes.
Check preparation-only diff scope and git diff --check.
No product suite, host mocks or prose existence tests required for documentary-only source/specification work.
integration_conditions: Distinct exact final substantive review; changed content invalidates affected review.
Actual A02 path/graph and current H01/S04 input reconciliation before integration.
Only canonical graph may record state; incomplete electrical pinning cannot be reported as B01 completion.
excluded: No production/driver/API crate or dependency installation.
No hardware support/release/physical admission, purchase, fuse, manufacturer contact or secret use.
